source: Bana 3D Şehir Oyunu Yap Şehire Binalar Evler Dükkanlar Alışveriş Merkezlerini Ekleyelim Şehirimizi Yapalım Tycoon Gibi

image_prompt.text: Physical barriers blocking the next district of the city that drop away when the plot is bought
A commercial core of shops and a shopping mall that players keep coming back to
Streets and sidewalks chaining the shopping core to the residential and commercial plots
Apartment and office buildings making up the city fabric and skyline
Detached houses clustered into residential streets

notes: Prompt is Turkish: a 3D city game with buildings, houses, shops and shopping malls, built up tycoon-style.
Tycoon preset taken whole; gate-progression and path-circulation are preset contributions, the shops and mall are the user's own.
The city's distinct residential and commercial districts have no option to express them.

open_questions.ask: Does each player build their own city plot, or is it one shared city everyone builds together?
What earns the money in the tycoon loop — rent from houses, sales from the shops, something else?

coverage_missing.ask: One shared city or a plot per player?
What generates income in the tycoon loop?
How big is the city — a few streets or a full skyline?

answers.ask: Does each player build their own city plot, or is it one shared city everyone builds together?
answers.answer: Her oyuncunun kendi şehir arsası olsun; herkes kendi şehrini tycoon mantığında ayrı ayrı geliştirsin.

answers.ask: What earns the money in the tycoon loop — rent from houses, sales from the shops, something else?
answers.answer: Para, evlerden gelen kira ve dükkânlar ile alışveriş merkezlerinden gelen satış geliriyle kazanılsın.
